pages.text: $(thing)Farms$(): all.$(br2)Adds an arrow on the $(item)left$() of the farm screen that pops out a $(item)side panel$(). Click a face (front, back, left, right, top, bottom) to cycle it: $(item)input and output$() (the normal behaviour), $(item)input only$(), $(item)output only$() or $(item)off$(). Faces set to output push items (and the tank of a Liquid Farm) into the container next to them. The back still feeds catalysts.
